# Session transfer — YYYY-MM-DD / task

Use for unfinished or substantial work when a new agent needs task-specific
continuity. Put the filled record in the daily log or a linked task artifact;
do not overwrite this reusable template. Link [start here](../handoff/README.md).

## User objective and authorization

- Exact intended outcome and acceptance criteria:
- Current user decisions/corrections; relevant original log/spec links:
- Authorized actions (local edits / commit / origin push / deploy / email):
- Explicitly deferred/prohibited work; approvals scoped to an earlier batch:

## Observed state (include date and time zone)

- Branch, HEAD, local tracking ref; whether/when remote was fetched:
- Dirty/untracked files and ownership; work that must be preserved:
- Last verified deployed web/worker revision and source of that evidence:
- Local server PID/port/health and last verification; unknowns:
- Pending migrations/configuration/external state; secrets omitted:

## Progress and reasoning

- Completed behavior and files:
- Root cause, chosen approach and why; alternatives rejected/superseded:
- Reproduction and meaningful edge/permission cases:
- External actions already executed and their recorded outcomes:
- Documentation/spec/backlog/ledger updated or still needing updates:

## Validation and evidence

- Exact pinned-runtime commands, dates, results and evidence paths:
- Full suite versus focused suite versus coverage gate:
- Desktop/mobile browser actions, screenshot review and current asset checks:
- Production health/source/schema/shakeout evidence if authorized:
- Email audit/handoff if required; explicitly outstanding if unsent/failed:
- Failures, blockers, test gaps and residual risks:

## Resume from here

1. Immediate next action and expected result:
2. Remaining ordered tasks; dependencies or pending user answers:
3. Production action/approval still required, if any:

Distinguish observed, recorded historical and inferred facts. Do not describe a
running command as completed; retain session/log identifiers when available.
